outline: 本課程討論當使用計算機來解決數學問題時的能力及限制，除了介紹傳統數值分析的問題與理論基礎外，並討論相關改進或解決的方法. 主題包含: (1) 誤差, (2) 數值演算法, (3) 數學計算軟體, (4) 浮點運算, (5) 矩陣運算, (6) 多項式內插法, (7)數值積分, (8)非線性方程式, (9)初值問題.
schedule:
Chapter 1. Introduction (1 week)
· Algorithms

· Errors

· Error propagation

· MATLAB exercises

Chapter 2. Floating-point Computations (1-2 weeks)
· Floating-point numbers

· Floating-point arithmetic (basic operations)

· Numerical instabilities

Chapter 3. Matrix Computations (3 weeks)
· Setting up matrix problems

· Matrix operations

· Solving linear systems

Chapter 4. Polynomial Interpolation (2 weeks)
· The Vandermonde approach

· The Newton representation

· Cubic splines

Chapter 5. Numerical Integration (2 weeks)
· The Newton-Cotes rules

· Composite rules

· Spline quadrature

Chapter 6. Nonlinear Equations (2 weeks)
· Bisection method

· Newton's method

· Secant method

Chapter 7. The Initial Value Problem (2 weeks)
· Basic concepts

· Euler's method

· The Runge-Kutta methods
scorePolicy:
Homework sets 30% (6-7 Homework sets)
Midterm exams 30% (TWO midterms, each 15%)
Final exam 40%
